title: 第二十一章 风停云归处岁岁伴清安第二十二章 静水藏微澜旧影引新踪
lines: 暮春午后，风暖日柔。
丞相府的海棠花期将近，余下的花瓣簌簌落在青石地上，铺了薄薄一层粉白。汀兰院静悄悄的，没有了往日的暗流汹涌，也没有了人心惶惶的紧绷，只剩岁月安稳的温柔。
沈清鸢坐在廊下的软榻上，一身素色衣裙，长发松松挽着简单发髻，只簪了一支温润的白玉簪。
经历后宅数年阴私、朝堂几番风浪，她眼底最后一丝少年时的清冷疏离，终于慢慢化开，多了几分松弛柔和。
春桃捧着一碟刚冰镇好的樱桃，轻轻放在石桌上，眉眼轻快：“小姐，整个京城都传遍了。前太子被贬庶人、终身圈禁，那些跟着作乱的官员全都被革职查办，再没人敢找相府的麻烦了。”
“还有官府那边传来消息，柳氏谋害主母、贪吞资产的罪名彻底定案，判了终身流放，此生永远不得回京。”
尘埃彻底落定。
那些纠缠了她两世的噩梦、血海深仇、家破人亡的恨意，今日尽数烟消云散。
沈清鸢拿起一颗樱桃，清甜微凉的滋味在舌尖化开，她轻轻颔首，眼底一片澄澈安宁。
前世她到死都没能等到的公道，今生一一圆满。
母亲沉冤得雪，沈家安然无恙，恶人皆得报应。
真好。
“对了小姐，王爷方才遣人来说，已经离府往这边来了。”春桃笑着补了一句。
话音刚落，院外便传来沉稳轻缓的脚步声。
萧聿辞一袭常服，墨色衣料素雅干净，褪去了朝堂上的杀伐冷厉，周身只剩温润平和。阳光落在他肩头，勾勒出挺拔清隽的身影，眉目温柔，不染半分尘霜。
他缓步走入院中，目光第一时间便落在廊下少女身上。
从前见她，或是步步谨慎、眼底藏锋，或是清冷戒备、满身倔强，今日却是难得的松弛安然，眉眼弯弯，安静又柔软。
萧聿辞心头微暖，缓步走近。
“今日无事，便来看看你。”
沈清鸢抬眸望他，浅浅一笑：“王爷辛苦了。今日朝堂之事，多谢你。”
若非他手握实权、步步兜底，若非他提前备好所有铁证、当庭力挽狂澜，仅凭父亲一人，根本无法轻易粉碎太子的党羽势力，更难这般干净利落了结所有风波。
这一路，她披荆斩棘，而他始终在她身后，默默为她挡尽所有风雨暗箭。
萧聿辞在她身侧站定，垂眸看着她，声音轻缓温柔：“无需言谢。我说过，护你，是我所愿。”
简简单单一句话，却重逾千金。
两世纠葛，半生羁绊。
他守着她的前世惨死，盼着她的今生安稳，从始至终，从未变过。
院中微风拂过，落英纷飞，花香浅浅。
沈清鸢心底微动，脸颊悄然染上一抹浅淡绯红，轻轻移开目光，轻声道：“如今风波尽了，往后，都安稳了。”
“嗯。”萧聿辞应声，目光温柔缱绻，牢牢落在她脸上，“往后，岁岁安稳，再无风波。”
不多时，老夫人带着丫鬟缓步过来，看见院中并肩而立的两人，眼底满是欣慰笑意。
这些日子的风雨，她尽数看在眼里。若非萧聿辞处处偏袒护持，鸢儿一个闺阁少女，想要扳倒盘踞多年的柳氏、抗衡当朝太子，何其艰难。
老夫人笑着开口：“王爷今日得空，便在府中用晚膳吧。”
萧聿辞微微颔首：“叨扰老夫人了。”
content_en:
In the late spring afternoon, the wind is warm and the sun is soft.
The blooming period of the crabapples in the Prime Minister's Mansion is approaching, and the remaining petals are rustling on the bluestone ground, spreading a thin layer of pink and white. Tinglan Courtyard is quiet, without the turbulent undercurrents of the past, nor the panic and tension of people's hearts, only the stable gentleness of the years remains.
Shen Qingyuan was sitting on the soft couch in the corridor, wearing a plain dress, with her long hair loosely pulled into a simple bun, and only a warm white jade hairpin.
After years of secrecy in the back house and several turmoils in the court, the last trace of the coldness and alienation in her youth slowly melted away in her eyes, becoming a bit more relaxed and soft.
Chuntao held a plate of freshly chilled cherries and placed it gently on the stone table. She said with a brisk look, "Miss, the news has spread throughout the capital. The former prince was demoted to a commoner and imprisoned for life. All the officials who followed the rebellion were dismissed and investigated. No one dares to cause trouble to the prime minister's office anymore."
"There is also news from the government that Liu's crime of murdering his mistress and embezzling assets has been completely confirmed. He has been sentenced to lifelong exile and will never be allowed to return to Beijing in this life."
The dust has completely settled.
The nightmares, the blood feud, the hatred of family destruction that had haunted her for two lifetimes were all gone today.
Shen Qingyuan picked up a cherry, and the sweet and slightly cool taste melted on the tip of her tongue. She nodded gently, her eyes clear and peaceful.
The justice that she could not wait for in her previous life until her death was fulfilled one by one in this life.
The mother's injustice was redressed, the Shen family was safe and sound, and all evildoers were punished.
very nice.
"By the way, miss, the prince just sent someone to tell you that he has already left the house and came here." Chuntao added with a smile.
As soon as he finished speaking, steady and gentle footsteps could be heard outside the courtyard.
Xiao Yuci was dressed in regular clothes. The dark-colored clothes were simple, elegant and clean. The murderous coldness in the court had faded away, leaving only warmth and peace around him. The sun fell on his shoulders, outlining his tall and clear figure, with gentle brows that were not stained by dust or frost.
He walked slowly into the courtyard, and his eyes immediately fell on the girl in the corridor.
In the past, when I saw her, she might be cautious with her steps and eyes hidden in her eyes, or she might be cold and guarded, with a stubborn body. But today, she is rare and relaxed, with curved eyebrows, quiet and soft.
Xiao Yuci's heart warmed slightly and he approached slowly.
"I have nothing to do today, so I came to see you."
Shen Qingyuan raised her eyes to look at him and smiled slightly: "Thank you for your hard work, Your Majesty. Thank you very much for today's court affairs."
If he hadn't held the real power and revealed every step of the way, if he hadn't prepared all the irrefutable evidence in advance and turned the tide in court, his father alone would not have been able to easily crush the prince's gang members, and it would have been even harder to end all the turmoil so neatly.
Along the way, she went through many obstacles, but he was always behind her, silently shielding her from all the storms and hidden arrows.
Xiao Yuci stood beside her, looked down at her, and said in a soft and gentle voice: "No need to say thank you. I said that it is my wish to protect you."
A simple sentence, but worth more than a thousand pieces of gold.
Two lifetimes of entanglement, half a lifetime of bondage.
He guarded her tragic death in her previous life and hoped for her stability in this life. From the beginning to the end, he never changed.
The breeze blows in the courtyard, fallen flowers are flying, and the fragrance of flowers is faint.
Shen Qingyuan's heart moved slightly, and her cheeks were quietly stained with a faint blush. She gently looked away and said softly: "Now that the storm is over, everything will be stable from now on."
"Yes." Xiao Yuci responded, his eyes gentle and affectionate, firmly fixed on her face, "From now on, there will be peace every year, and there will be no more troubles."
Not long after, the old lady came slowly over with her maid, and when she saw the two people standing side by side in the courtyard, her eyes were full of happy smiles.
She has seen all the wind and rain these days. If it weren't for Xiao Yuci's partiality and support in every aspect, it would be extremely difficult for Yuan'er, a girl from a boudoir, to overthrow the Liu family that had been in power for many years and challenge the current prince.
The old lady smiled and said, "Your Majesty is free today, so you can have dinner at the mansion."
Xiao Yuci nodded slightly: "I'm disturbing the old lady."
title_en: Chapter 21: When the wind stops and the clouds return, I will accompany you all year round. Chapter 22: The still water hides the slight waves, old shadows lead to new traces.
